#### [1. Awesome Swift](/content/matteocrippa/awesome-swift/README.md)

#### [7. Awesome Gemini Cli](/content/Piebald-AI/awesome-gemini-cli/README.md)

##### Commands & Extensions

*   [Dex (⭐92)](https://github.com/exmergo/dex) - Gemini CLI extension with three Agent Skills for analytics engineering: explore a warehouse or DuckDB file read-only (profiles, PII flags, verified joins), author dbt models and semantic layers as reviewable diffs, and detect schema drift. Install with `gemini extensions install https://github.com/exmergo/dex`; needs `uv`.

##### MCP Servers

*   [BlockVectra (⭐0)](https://github.com/blockvectra/mcp) - MCP server for Robinhood Chain and multiple EVM networks. Connect over remote Streamable HTTP to discover chains and read docs without a key; RPC access follows each chain's policy, while Data API and account tools need an API key. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/blockvectra/mcp --ref main`.
*   [CodeTrendy](https://codetrendy.com/mcp?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Search CodeTrendy, a curated directory of newly launched startups, SaaS tools and indie products, from Gemini CLI: keyword search with category and pricing filters, full listing profiles, alternatives to a named product, trending listings and the site of the day. 7 read-only tools. Remote Streamable HTTP, no API key, no account: `gemini mcp add --transport http codetrendy https://codetrendy.com/api/mcp`.
*   [MEDIAPRONET](https://mediapronet.com/mcp?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Search the MEDIAPRONET launch and discovery directory from Gemini CLI: keyword search over newly launched startups, SaaS tools and online products (category and pricing filters), full listing profiles, alternatives to a named product, categories and what is trending. 7 read-only tools. Remote Streamable HTTP, no API key, no account. Works with any MCP client including Gemini CLI: `gemini mcp add --transport http mediapronet https://mediapronet.com/api/mcp`.
*   [LLMSlim (⭐21)](https://github.com/Thanatos9404/llmslim) - Long-term memory for Gemini CLI and other MCP clients over a local stdio MCP server. Five tools (`remember`, `recall`, `list_memories`, `forget`, `fit_context`): messages are stored word for word in local SQLite or your own Postgres, and `recall` returns the stored messages that answer a question within a token budget, with no LLM call inside. MIT. Install: `pip install "llmslim[mcp]"`, then `gemini mcp add --scope user llmslim llmslim mcp`.

##### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [OpenMoat (⭐2)](https://github.com/crocodile-labs/openmoat) - Local policy layer with a `BeforeTool` hook for Gemini CLI (`openmoat init`) that checks every shell command, file read and write, web request and MCP call against one policy before it runs, blocking what the policy denies. Adds an egress proxy, MCP server pinning and a hash-chained audit log, and the same policy covers Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents. Rust, MIT OR Apache-2.0.

#### [8. Awesome Amazon Seller](/content/ScaleLeap/awesome-amazon-seller/README.md)

##### Software and Tools

*   [ChineseCheck](https://chinesecheck.com) - Verify a Chinese supplier before paying: look up the company by English name, Chinese name or Unified Social Credit Code and read its registration record in English for free; paid reports add court enforcement, litigation and penalty records.
*   [ScrapeUnblocker](https://docs.scrapeunblocker.com/plugins/amazon) - Web scraping API with Amazon endpoints that return JSON: product pages (price, list price, availability, rating, seller, images), search results with sponsored and Prime flags, Best Sellers and other ranked lists, and review data with the star histogram, across Amazon's regional marketplaces. Also available as an MCP server.
*   [RefVid](https://refvid.com) - AI product video generator that keeps label, logo and packaging consistent across clips, from 1-5 photos or an Amazon product link. Free credits on sign-up.
*   [Utlista](https://www.utlista.com) - Localises an existing product catalogue into Amazon listings for seven EU marketplaces (de, fr, it, es, nl, pl, se). Writes title, five bullets, description and backend search terms per destination marketplace rather than translating them, and validates every field against Amazon's limits before export, including search terms counted in bytes. Produces a flat file per marketplace; it does not upload to Amazon. Free for ten products.
*   [Vendooly](https://vendooly.com/en/) - MCP connector that brings Seller Central and Amazon Ads into ChatGPT and Claude through the official Amazon APIs. The AI prepares each change with a before/after preview and it runs only after your approval. 14-day free trial.
*   [VNCNT Labs Keyword Research](https://apify.com/vncntlabs/keyword-ideas) - Reverse ASIN (the Amazon keywords any ASIN ranks for) and keyword ideas from a seed via Amazon related searches and Google autocomplete, with search volume, CPC, difficulty and a USPTO trademark flag. Runs on Apify, pay per result from $0.002 per keyword, no subscription.

1. Awesome Swift

AI

Newsletter

Third party Guides

Chart

Colors

Images / Barcode

UI / Barcode

AI / Voxel Editors

Plugins / Internationalization

  • I18n Leak (⭐0) - Finds i18n bugs with no string literal to scan: form constraints whose validation message the browser renders in its own locale, and raw error.message text reaching the user.
  • i18next (⭐175) - Finds untranslated string literals in source, with markupOnly and jsx-only modes to narrow the scan.

Plugins / Practices and Specific ES Features

  • import-next (⭐18) - Drop-in replacement for eslint-plugin-import with a rewritten cycle detector and no config changes required.
  • import-boundary (⭐7) - Enforces import boundaries from directory nesting: only a parent may import a direct child's public entry (index), with rootFiles / sharedFiles escapes.
  • eslint-plugin-intlayer (⭐855) - ESLint plugin for i18n purpose.

Plugins / Security

  • secure-coding (⭐18) - Security rules with CWE and OWASP Top 10 metadata, and machine-readable fix guidance in each message.

Tools / Testing Tools

Commands & Extensions

  • Dex (⭐92) - Gemini CLI extension with three Agent Skills for analytics engineering: explore a warehouse or DuckDB file read-only (profiles, PII flags, verified joins), author dbt models and semantic layers as reviewable diffs, and detect schema drift. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/exmergo/dex; needs uv.

MCP Servers

  • BlockVectra (⭐0) - MCP server for Robinhood Chain and multiple EVM networks. Connect over remote Streamable HTTP to discover chains and read docs without a key; RPC access follows each chain's policy, while Data API and account tools need an API key. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/blockvectra/mcp --ref main.
  • CodeTrendy - Search CodeTrendy, a curated directory of newly launched startups, SaaS tools and indie products, from Gemini CLI: keyword search with category and pricing filters, full listing profiles, alternatives to a named product, trending listings and the site of the day. 7 read-only tools. Remote Streamable HTTP, no API key, no account: gemini mcp add --transport http codetrendy https://codetrendy.com/api/mcp.
  • MEDIAPRONET - Search the MEDIAPRONET launch and discovery directory from Gemini CLI: keyword search over newly launched startups, SaaS tools and online products (category and pricing filters), full listing profiles, alternatives to a named product, categories and what is trending. 7 read-only tools. Remote Streamable HTTP, no API key, no account. Works with any MCP client including Gemini CLI: gemini mcp add --transport http mediapronet https://mediapronet.com/api/mcp.
  • LLMSlim (⭐21) - Long-term memory for Gemini CLI and other MCP clients over a local stdio MCP server. Five tools (remember, recall, list_memories, forget, fit_context): messages are stored word for word in local SQLite or your own Postgres, and recall returns the stored messages that answer a question within a token budget, with no LLM call inside. MIT. Install: pip install "llmslim[mcp]", then gemini mcp add --scope user llmslim llmslim mcp.

#### [1. Awesome Bigdata](/content/newTendermint/awesome-bigdata/README.md)

##### Data Ingestion

*   [OLake (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/datazip-inc/olake) - Open-source replication of Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Kafka and S3 into Apache Iceberg, with CDC and table maintenance. Written in Go.
*   [Datanika](https://datanika.io) - open-source ELT platform pairing dlt extract-and-load with dbt-core transformations, plus scheduling and run history in one self-hosted UI.

##### Distributed Tracing Platform

*   [Jaeger](https://www.jaegertracing.io/) - Jaeger: open source, distributed tracing platform for monitor and troubleshoot workflows in complex distributed systems

##### Columnar Databases

*   [KoldStore (⭐6)](https://github.com/kalamdb/koldstore) - experimental PostgreSQL tiered-storage extension that moves historical rows to Parquet and queries supported hot and cold data through the original table; not production-ready.

##### Benchmarking

*   [HiBench Next (⭐1)](https://github.com/mgarralda/HiBench-Next) - Modernized HiBench suite for reproducible Apache Spark benchmarking, featuring 24 Scala/PySpark workloads, Web UI, REST API, and CLI.
*   [DeathStarBench (⭐957)](https://github.com/delimitrou/DeathStarBench) - Open-source benchmark suite for cloud microservices.
*   [CloudSuite (⭐239)](https://github.com/parsa-epfl/cloudsuite) - A Benchmark Suite for Cloud Services.
*   [YCSB (⭐5.2k)](https://github.com/brianfrankcooper/YCSB) - Yahoo! Cloud Serving Benchmark
*   [TailBench](https://tailbench.csail.mit.edu/) - TailBench: A Benchmark Suite and Evaluation Methodology for Latency-Critical Applications
*   [SProBench (⭐2)](https://github.com/apurvkulkarni7/SProBench) - SProBench: Stream Processing Benchmark for High Performance Computing

##### Applications

*   [TradeData](https://tradedata.io) - API for customs, shipment and international trade data, supporting supply-chain and market analysis.

##### Search engine and framework

*   [Manticore Search (⭐12k)](https://github.com/manticoresoftware/manticoresearch) - open-source search database for full-text, vector, and hybrid search with real-time indexing and SQL.

##### Business Intelligence

*   [Beekeeper Studio](https://www.beekeeperstudio.io/) - cross-platform SQL client for querying and exploring analytical databases and warehouses like ClickHouse, BigQuery, Redshift, and DuckDB.
*   [DAC (⭐795)](https://github.com/bruin-data/dac) - dashboard-as-code tool defining dashboards in YAML and TSX, with a built-in semantic layer.

##### Data Visualization

*   [FlexViz (⭐73)](https://github.com/flex-analytics/flexviz) - open-source Python library for interactive cross-filter dashboards on large datasets, answering each zoom and selection with a lazy Polars aggregation instead of sending rows to the browser.

#### [2. Awesome Storybook](/content/lauthieb/awesome-storybook/README.md)

##### Examples

*   [ElementsKit UI - Storybook](https://elements-kit.com/storybook/)

#### [3. Awesome Mqtt](/content/awesome-mqtt/awesome-mqtt/README.md)

##### Brokers

*   [VelaMQ](https://www.velamq.com/) - Rust-based MQTT broker with clustering, a web console, authentication, topic ACLs, and a SQL rule engine.

##### Tools

*   [MQTT Scope (⭐1)](https://github.com/ToRexZ/mqtt-scope) - Desktop MQTT client for Linux, Windows and macOS with a live topic tree, a large-message inspector with diff, and live plots of any JSON field. [Website](https://torexz.github.io/mqtt-scope/).

#### [4. Awesome Integration](/content/stn1slv/awesome-integration/README.md)

Covers site audits, keyword research, meta tags, schema markup, GEO optimization, wasted-spend detection, and creative analysis. (Source Code (⭐3.9k)) MIT

Privacy focused analytics

  • Logly - Cookieless web analytics with a sub-1KB tracker. Bots are counted separately and labelled by type — search engines, AI crawlers, SEO tools, monitors — instead of being filtered out silently. © SaaS
  • Stomatopod - Privacy-friendly, cookieless self-hosted web analytics. Single binary, embedded storage, no external DB. (Source Code (⭐1)) MIT Rust/Docker
  • Respectlytics - Privacy-first, session-based mobile app analytics with strict 5-field storage and no persistent user tracking. (Source Code (⭐41)) AGPL-3.0 Python/Docker
  • PageLens - Cookieless, EU-hosted web analytics with revenue by traffic source and AI Visibility: which pages ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity read, use in answers and send visitors to. (Demo) © SaaS EU
  • Lomen - Cookie-free website analytics with an AI you can ask about your traffic, revenue from Stripe, Shopify, Lemon Squeezy and Polar next to visitors, and tracking of visits from ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity. (Demo) © SaaS
  • measuremy.site - Cookieless web analytics your AI agent can read: an MCP server lets Claude Code, Cursor and other agents install the script and answer traffic questions. (Source Code (⭐1) for the self-hosted version) © SaaS MIT Self-Hosted
  • DevDome Analytics - Cookieless analytics for WordPress that separates human visitors from bots and AI crawlers. Free plan. (Plugin Source Code (⭐0)) GPL-2.0 SaaS
  • Statable - Privacy-first, cookieless web analytics hosted in the EU. Import your Google Analytics 4 history and keep a unified timeline. © SaaS EU
  • Facet (⭐2) - Cookieless, privacy-first web analytics & experimentation that runs entirely on the Cloudflare edge (Workers + D1). No cookies, no cross-session identity, raw IP is never stored; GPC/DNT respecting and self-hosted with a one-command deploy. AGPL-3.0 Cloudflare Workers
  • Ucoder Insight - Privacy-first, cookie-free web analytics SDK for developers. 7.4kb gzipped, zero dependencies, offline support via IndexDB. (Source Code (⭐2)) MIT JavaScript
  • Beam - Lightweight, cookie-free web analytics on Cloudflare Workers and D1. No cookies, no fingerprinting, GDPR-compliant by design. Free tier included. (Source Code (⭐0)) © SaaS
  • Measure.events - Privacy-first web analytics with an agent-native API, MCP server, and natural language summaries. Built for AI-forward teams. © SaaS
  • d8a.tech - Open-source, GA4/Matomo-compatible analytics. Warehouse-native storage in BigQuery, ClickHouse, or files (CSV/Parquet). Available as EU-hosted cloud or self-hosted. MIT SaaS Self-Hosted Go/Docker

Heatmap analytics

  • Lupa - Self-hosted click heatmaps rendered directly on your page (no iframe), top clicked elements and scroll depth, plus session replay. (Demo, Source Code (⭐0)) AGPL-3.0 Go Self-Hosted
  • Hoot Lens - session replay, click heatmaps by device class and broken-click detection, readable by AI coding agents over MCP. © SaaS

App store analytics

  • AdMapix - AI ad intelligence and app market research platform for searching competitor creatives and tracking app rankings, downloads, and revenue across markets. © SaaS

Attribution tracking

  • ClickTrail - Deterministic first-party attribution engine for UTMs, ad click IDs, referrers, and first/last touch. (Source Code (⭐3)) MIT TypeScript
  • WhichPost - See which creator posts brought paying customers, from a read-only Stripe or RevenueCat connection, with a range on every result. © SaaS
  • Virling (⭐1) - open-source revenue attribution that ties each visit to the Stripe, Dodo Payments or Polar payment that followed. AGPL-3.0 Self-Hosted
  • OneLence - Marketing analytics: what to scale, hold or stop across ads, SEO, AI search and affiliates. © SaaS
  • mbuzz - server-side multi-touch attribution platform with open-source SDKs for Ruby, Node, Python, and PHP, plus a SQL-like attribution DSL. © SaaS

Social media analytics

  • Open Channel Stats - Browse real YouTube channels' full owner analytics — retention, CTR, traffic sources — published by the creators themselves, not estimated; connect your own free to compare. Daily refresh; each public channel exports as a documented SQLite file. © SaaS
  • SocialBu - AI-powered social media management and analytics platform with scheduling, monitoring, and automation. © SaaS
  • AI TikTok Analyzer Pro - TikTok content research: rank a creator's public videos by engagement, export comments, AI transcripts and sentiment analysis. © SaaS
  • Pulse - Social post metrics REST API — give it a public post URL and get back views, likes, comments, shares in JSON. Covers YouTube, X/Twitter, TikTok, Bluesky, Mastodon, Instagram. No API key to start. Free SaaS

Developer analytics

  • Dev Ledger - Open-source GitHub analytics for developers — longitudinal development history across repositories: source growth, churn, activity, languages, and releases. (Source Code (⭐0)) AGPL-3.0 SaaS

14. Awesome Rust

Applications / Productivity

15. Magictools

Graphics / Spritesheet Tools

  • 🆓 PicMason Sprite Sheet Splitter - Browser-based fixed-grid splitter with custom frame sizes, offsets and spacing. Exports PNG frames preserving source transparency and a ZIP with source coordinates; can skip fully transparent frames.

Graphics / Vector/Image Editor

Graphics / Modeling

  • 🎉 Inca - Free, open-source 3D modeling, animation and rendering app that works like Maya 2020, with OBJ, FBX, glTF and STL import.

AI / Voxel Editors

17. Awesome Mac

AI Tools / Other Tools

  • Frink - Desktop-first, open-source (MIT) application for running parallel agents, and multi-step custom workflows triggered by schedules, webhooks or events from tools like Linear and Sentry, across your already-used providers.
  • Cove - Open-source native composer, session sidebar and diff viewer for Claude Code and Codex, currently available as an Apple Silicon preview.
  • Enconvo - AI agent that understands your screen and completes tasks across apps.

Developer Tools / API Development and Analysis

  • Optics Framework - Open-source UI test automation for Android, iOS, web and smart TV apps, with tests written as CSV or YAML steps.

Developer Tools / Databases

  • DBine - Open-source database manager for 130+ SQL and NoSQL databases and cloud services, with notebooks, schema and data compare, and an MCP server.

Utilities / Audio Record and Process

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

Gaming Software / System Related Tools

Video

Web Development / Template Engines

MCP Servers

  • npmscan (⭐2) - npm supply-chain security: checks packages for malware, known vulnerabilities, typosquats, maintainer takeovers and risky install scripts before install, and audits package.json, lockfiles, SBOMs and PR dependency changes. 23 read-only tools, no API key, no signup. Remote Streamable HTTP, bundled with 5 skills as a Gemini CLI extension. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/salemalem/npmscan-mcp-plugin.

#### [1. Awesome Testing](/content/TheJambo/awesome-testing/README.md) ##### Software / Service Virtualization * [fieldtwin](https://nickgeorgeai.com/fieldtwin) - Open-source, local, stateful twins of the Jobber and QuickBooks Online APIs for integration and AI agent tests, with checkpoints, rewind, and faults on demand. * [MockForge (⭐12)](https://github.com/SaaSy-Solutions/mockforge) - Open-source API mock server written in Rust for HTTP/OpenAPI, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket, Kafka, MQTT and AMQP, with data generation and latency/fault injection. ##### Software / UI & End-to-End Testing * [Device Hub Pro (⭐1)](https://github.com/gitemre/device-hub-pro) - Free, open-source macOS app for manual testing on Android emulators, Android phones and iOS simulators side by side, with live mirroring, device controls (network, location, permissions, deep links, push), logs, screenshots and screen recordings. * [App Crash Lab (⭐3)](https://github.com/aichance/business-ai-recipes/tree/main/tools/app-crash-lab) - MIT-licensed Node 22+/Playwright CLI that checks saved web-app values after reload and rejected updates, exporting state diffs and standalone Playwright tests. * [Proxy QA Browser (⭐1)](https://github.com/UbaidBinWaris/proxy_browser) - Free, open-source desktop app to test your own web forms by US location, emulated device and browser, with recorded scenarios, consent and accessibility checks, and a CI runner. * [vibe-testing (⭐17)](https://github.com/AishwaryShrivastav/vibe-testing) - Open-source MCP server and CLI that scans web app routes and forms, runs browser checks with Playwright, and produces HTML QA reports. * [Device Changer](https://deviceschanger.org) - Applies device models, build fingerprints and identifiers to rooted Android test devices to reproduce device-specific bugs. ##### Software / Accessibility & Usability Testing * [Oh My Android (⭐60)](https://github.com/ateymoori/oh-my-android) - Free, open-source macOS app for checking Android apps on emulators and phones in dark mode, large font sizes, RTL and TalkBack, with a TalkBack-order accessibility audit. * [AuditReady](https://feaefe371424d0725b266468856c9101.ctonew.app/) - Runs 12 deterministic HTML checks on a page against WCAG 2.2 and returns the matching criterion and a suggested fix for each finding, then turns them into a printable report an agency can hand to its client. Free instant scan; the full report is a one-off $29. ##### Software / API Testing * [API Spector](https://api-spector.dev) - Open-source API clien, mock server and contract testing tool. Zero telemetry. * [Openhook (⭐1)](https://github.com/openhook-dev/openhook-inbox) - Open-source webhook inbox for capturing callbacks and inspecting request headers and bodies through a browser, REST API, or MCP. ##### Software / AI & LLM Testing * [fanout-check (⭐1)](https://github.com/sunxiuguo/fanout-check) - Offline Python library and CLI that checks observed concurrency, overlap, and launch timing in explicitly grouped tool or agent calls. ##### Software / Visual Testing * [CurlShot](https://curlshot.com) - Screenshot API for capturing baseline and comparison images of web pages in CI as PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF, with full-page and CSS-selector element capture, device presets and ad/cookie-banner blocking. Free plan available. * [cloneproof (⭐0)](https://github.com/pcjansen09-max/cloneproof) - Scores how closely a website clone matches the original (pixels, layout, style, scroll motion) with Playwright and lists the exact differences. ##### Software / Test Data Management * [TempMail Hub](https://tempmailhub.net/) - Free disposable inbox for manual or scripted signup and email-verification testing, with a selectable lifetime from 10 minutes to 7 days and no account required. * [Mails.ai](https://mails.ai/docs/email-testing) - Email inboxes for automated tests: a plus address per test and one call that waits for the email and returns the sign-up code or magic link, with TypeScript and Python SDKs, Cypress and Playwright packages and an MCP server. * [ByteRivet Sample Files](https://byterivet.com/test-files/) - Free browser-based generator for exact-size dummy files from 1 KB to 2 GB in 22 formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, JSON, ZIP, MP4, WAV and more) for upload-limit and file-handling tests. Files are built locally, no upload or signup. * [FormFiller test data tools](https://formfillerapp.com/tools/) - Free browser-based generators for fake addresses, identities, IBANs, test card numbers and bulk CSV/JSON/SQL data in 22 locales. ##### Software / Browser Extensions & Utilities * [Keploy API Test Recorder](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/keploy-api-test-recorder/ohcclfkaidblnjnggclkiecgkpgldihe) - Chrome extension that records API calls from your browser session and turns them into API tests. ##### Software / Performance & Load Testing * [vhr-bench (⭐2)](https://github.com/vpshostreview/vhr-vps-benchmark) - One-minute Linux server benchmark of CPU, memory and 4k random disk IOPS using sysbench and fio. ##### Software / Test Automation Frameworks * [behave (⭐2)](https://github.com/emirmrkaljevic/behave) - Records how a command-line tool behaves (flags, stdin, exit codes, edge cases) as golden tests and replays them against another implementation, e.g. a Rust or Go rewrite. ##### Software / Static Analysis * [SmartBench (⭐2)](https://github.com/xianyu-sheng/SmartBench) - Open-source CLI for evidence-constrained code audits: deterministic static analysis owns the facts and LLM hypotheses must be validated against the code before they become findings. ##### Newsletters / Static Analysis * [RoleGig QA & Testing](https://rolegig.com/qa-testing/) - Weekly list of QA, test automation and SDET jobs in India, the US, Canada, Europe, Australia and the Gulf. #### [2. Open Source Mac Os Apps](/content/serhii-londar/open-source-mac-os-apps/README.md) ##### 👨‍💻 Development (54) * [Blave Agent (⭐113)](https://github.com/Blave-TW/blave-agent) - Desktop workspace where your own Claude Code or Codex writes trading strategies, backtests them and runs them live on crypto exchanges. **Languages:** Python JavaScript **Website:**

1. Awesome Testing

Software / Service Virtualization

  • fieldtwin - Open-source, local, stateful twins of the Jobber and QuickBooks Online APIs for integration and AI agent tests, with checkpoints, rewind, and faults on demand.
  • MockForge (⭐12) - Open-source API mock server written in Rust for HTTP/OpenAPI, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket, Kafka, MQTT and AMQP, with data generation and latency/fault injection.

Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

  • Device Hub Pro (⭐1) - Free, open-source macOS app for manual testing on Android emulators, Android phones and iOS simulators side by side, with live mirroring, device controls (network, location, permissions, deep links, push), logs, screenshots and screen recordings.
  • App Crash Lab (⭐3) - MIT-licensed Node 22+/Playwright CLI that checks saved web-app values after reload and rejected updates, exporting state diffs and standalone Playwright tests.
  • Proxy QA Browser (⭐1) - Free, open-source desktop app to test your own web forms by US location, emulated device and browser, with recorded scenarios, consent and accessibility checks, and a CI runner.
  • vibe-testing (⭐17) - Open-source MCP server and CLI that scans web app routes and forms, runs browser checks with Playwright, and produces HTML QA reports.
  • Device Changer - Applies device models, build fingerprints and identifiers to rooted Android test devices to reproduce device-specific bugs.

Software / Accessibility & Usability Testing

  • Oh My Android (⭐60) - Free, open-source macOS app for checking Android apps on emulators and phones in dark mode, large font sizes, RTL and TalkBack, with a TalkBack-order accessibility audit.
  • AuditReady - Runs 12 deterministic HTML checks on a page against WCAG 2.2 and returns the matching criterion and a suggested fix for each finding, then turns them into a printable report an agency can hand to its client. Free instant scan; the full report is a one-off $29.

Software / API Testing

  • API Spector - Open-source API clien, mock server and contract testing tool. Zero telemetry.
  • Openhook (⭐1) - Open-source webhook inbox for capturing callbacks and inspecting request headers and bodies through a browser, REST API, or MCP.

Software / AI & LLM Testing

  • fanout-check (⭐1) - Offline Python library and CLI that checks observed concurrency, overlap, and launch timing in explicitly grouped tool or agent calls.

Software / Visual Testing

  • CurlShot - Screenshot API for capturing baseline and comparison images of web pages in CI as PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF, with full-page and CSS-selector element capture, device presets and ad/cookie-banner blocking. Free plan available.
  • cloneproof (⭐0) - Scores how closely a website clone matches the original (pixels, layout, style, scroll motion) with Playwright and lists the exact differences.

Software / Test Data Management

  • TempMail Hub - Free disposable inbox for manual or scripted signup and email-verification testing, with a selectable lifetime from 10 minutes to 7 days and no account required.
  • Mails.ai - Email inboxes for automated tests: a plus address per test and one call that waits for the email and returns the sign-up code or magic link, with TypeScript and Python SDKs, Cypress and Playwright packages and an MCP server.
  • ByteRivet Sample Files - Free browser-based generator for exact-size dummy files from 1 KB to 2 GB in 22 formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, JSON, ZIP, MP4, WAV and more) for upload-limit and file-handling tests. Files are built locally, no upload or signup.
  • FormFiller test data tools - Free browser-based generators for fake addresses, identities, IBANs, test card numbers and bulk CSV/JSON/SQL data in 22 locales.

Software / Browser Extensions & Utilities

  • Keploy API Test Recorder - Chrome extension that records API calls from your browser session and turns them into API tests.

Software / Performance & Load Testing

  • vhr-bench (⭐2) - One-minute Linux server benchmark of CPU, memory and 4k random disk IOPS using sysbench and fio.

Software / Test Automation Frameworks

  • behave (⭐2) - Records how a command-line tool behaves (flags, stdin, exit codes, edge cases) as golden tests and replays them against another implementation, e.g. a Rust or Go rewrite.

Software / Static Analysis

  • SmartBench (⭐2) - Open-source CLI for evidence-constrained code audits: deterministic static analysis owns the facts and LLM hypotheses must be validated against the code before they become findings.

Newsletters / Static Analysis

  • RoleGig QA & Testing - Weekly list of QA, test automation and SDET jobs in India, the US, Canada, Europe, Australia and the Gulf.

Contract annotations (@kern:requires/@kern:ensures) are checked in Python, Zig, C and Rust, and the toolchain ships 125 Lean 4 theorems with 0 sorry. AI-assisted.

Network & Web / Network

  • Prusti — A static verifier for Rust, based on the Viper verification infrastructure. By default Prusti verifies absence of panics by proving that statements such as unreachable!() and panic!() are unreachable.

Tools

Projects

  • Orbit OS - Android-like platform installed on top of Raspberry Pi OS: signed apps from an app store, atomic OTA updates, and Go, Python and Java SDKs to control GPIO, I²C, UART and the camera, with a VS Code extension (Orbit Studio) to run code live on the Pi and deploy in one click. Supports Raspberry Pi 3, 4, 5 and Zero 2 W.

Applications

Applications / Database

Applications / Image processing

  • Hugo-Dz/spritefusion-sprite-normals (⭐113) - A CLI and WebAssembly tool that generates normal maps from pixel art sprites and animations (MIT).

Libraries / Cryptography

  • po0uyan/memsafe (⭐116) [memsafe] - Locked, sealed, zero-on-drop memory for secrets.

13. Magictools

Graphics / Texture Tools

  • 🎉 Sprite Fusion Sprite Normals (⭐113) - Generate normal maps from pixel art sprites and animations.

AI / Voxel Editors

  • 🆓 WishlistForge Steam Description Scorer - free in-browser scorer for Steam short descriptions. It checks length, hook, genre clarity, player fantasy and call to action, and suggests a rewrite. No account needed.

Collections / Voxel Editors

  • 🆓 PulseLite UI SFX - 20 free UI sounds (clicks, hovers, confirms, errors, rewards) in WAV/OGG, procedurally synthesized with no samples or AI audio models, sounds CC BY 4.0, plus an optional Godot 4 drop-in script (MIT).

Music and Audio Editors / Voxel Editors

  • 💸 CICA AUDIO - AI sound effect generator for games and UI. Analyzes gameplay recordings, detects sound events, and generates synchronized WAV files.

Project Management / Voxel Editors

  • 💸 Gamifying - Browser workspace for game design: characters, quests, items and lore as linked entries, with Kanban board, timeline and JSON export.

14. Awesome Mac

Security / System Security

  • RockxyApp/Shieldxy (⭐3) — Auditable application firewall and connection monitor for macOS ☆18

15. Awesome Gemini Cli

MCP Servers

  • Firecrawl - Official Firecrawl MCP server for web search, page scraping to markdown or JSON, and site crawling. The hosted server works keyless (rate limited) with search, scrape and parse; add an API key for crawl, map and the rest. The open-source server is MIT (source (⭐7.6k)). Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http firecrawl https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp.

16. Free for Dev

APIs, Data, and ML

  • cors.dev - CORS proxy for calling third-party APIs from frontend code: prefix any HTTPS URL with https://proxy.cors.dev/. Free without signup or an API key for GET and HEAD requests, 600 requests per minute per IP, responses up to 1 MiB, no monthly quota.
  • Dynamic Document API - Turn data into pixel-perfect PDFs and images. The free plan includes 50 renders per month and access to 2 templates from the template gallery or your own.

Tools for Teams and Collaboration

  • MergeMe - MergeMe brings GitHub/GitLab PRs/MRs directly into Slack as 1 constantly updating card. It adds CI status, mirrored comments, @mentions, reminders & more. Free for teams up to 5 developers & 1 channel mapping.

Monitoring

  • OpenUptime - Hosted uptime monitoring and status pages. Free tier includes 3 active monitors with 5-minute check intervals, 26,000 checks and 100 emails per month, and 30 days of check history.

Email

  • DMARCmetric - DMARC report monitoring with named sending sources, SPF/DKIM alignment and plain-English summaries. Free for 1 domain: 10,000 messages/month, 30-day history, email alerts, no credit card.

Data Visualization on Maps

  • opengeocoding.com - Source-available geocoder in Rust: address search, autocomplete and reverse geocoding on open data. Self-host it or use the hosted API. Fifty thousand free queries/month.

#### [1. Awesome Javascript](/content/sorrycc/awesome-javascript/README.md)

##### SDK / Other

*   [Social SDK (⭐711)](https://github.com/opencoredev/social-sdk) - Typed JavaScript and TypeScript client for posting and reading across social platforms on Node.js and Bun.

#### [2. Open Source Flutter Apps](/content/tortuvshin/open-source-flutter-apps/README.md)

##### Productivity

*   [akou](https://openappscout.com/apps/akou/) - akou is a GPL-3.0 call recorder for Apple silicon Macs that transcribes on the device, with no bot in the meeting and no account, and saves the notes to files you own. ([Source (⭐14)](https://github.com/GeiserX/akou))

##### Tools

*   [VPN Bypass](https://openappscout.com/apps/vpn-bypass/) - A macOS menu bar app that sends chosen services and domains around a corporate VPN, or only those through it, and puts the routes back when the VPN reconnects. ([Source (⭐127)](https://github.com/GeiserX/VPN-Bypass))

##### Developer Tools

*   [Device Hub Pro](https://openappscout.com/apps/device-hub-pro/) - Native macOS app to manage and mirror Android emulators, Android phones, iOS simulators and iPhones side by side. ([Source (⭐1)](https://github.com/gitemre/device-hub-pro))
*   [Orbi](https://openappscout.com/apps/orbi/) - Orbi is an AGPL-3.0 system that turns labelled GitHub issues into reviewed, merged pull requests and tagged releases, using GitHub issues as its only state store; Orbi Cloud is the hosted offering. ([Source (⭐220)](https://github.com/orbi-build/orbi))
*   [SolidPing](https://openappscout.com/apps/solidping/) - SolidPing is an AGPL-3.0 uptime monitor that runs as a single Go binary or Docker image, on SQLite by default, with a hosted free plan. ([Source (⭐17)](https://github.com/fclairamb/solidping))

##### Games

*   [Patzer](https://openappscout.com/apps/patzer/) - Self-hosted Chess.com alternative: game review for your Chess.com and Lichess games, play vs Stockfish or a friend, AI coach on your own Ollama or vLLM, in one Docker container. ([Source (⭐42)](https://github.com/SikamikanikoBG/patzer))

##### Travel

*   [Pumperly](https://openappscout.com/apps/pumperly/) - Pumperly is an AGPL-3.0 map of fuel prices and EV chargers with a route planner, free to use at pumperly.com with no account or to run yourself with Docker Compose. ([Source (⭐44)](https://github.com/GeiserX/Pumperly))

#### [3. Awesome Mysql](/content/shlomi-noach/awesome-mysql/README.md)

##### Binlog-Replication

*   [dbtrail (⭐64)](https://github.com/dbtrail/dbtrail) - Analytical replica of MySQL: keeps tables as Parquet files fed from the binlog, queried with DuckDB

#### [4. Awesome Quant](/content/wilsonfreitas/awesome-quant/README.md)

##### Market Data & Data Sources

*   [alphai-tui (⭐77)](https://github.com/makeev/alphai-tui) - `Rust` `TUI` - Terminal stock dashboard with keyless quotes, candlestick charts and portfolio tracking, plus optional news and SEC filing views powered by the AlphAI API.
*   [prop-firm-rules (⭐1)](https://github.com/kburrus64-max/prop-firm-rules) - `Python` `JavaScript` `Data` - Sourced, dated dataset of prop-trading-firm daily-loss and max-drawdown rules (static and trailing, lock levels, reset times) for 9 firms and 13 programs, with a zero-dependency JS/Python drawdown calculator.
*   [canli-pit-lake (⭐0)](https://github.com/arhancanli/canli-pit-lake) - `Python` `DuckDB` `Parquet` - Point-in-time market-data lake where every read takes an explicit as-of, corporate actions filter on when they became knowable, and delisted names are kept.
*   [Gloomberb (⭐2.5k)](https://github.com/gloom-sh/gloomberb) - `TypeScript` `Bun` - Open-source finance terminal for quotes, charts, news, filings and portfolios, as a terminal UI, desktop app and web app.
*   [Fonrex](https://fonrex.io) - `Python` `Docker` `REST` - Self-hosted financial data API for European and US markets: prices per listing, cross-checked fundamentals from 18 sources, DCF valuation and Fama/French factors in your own PostgreSQL. [GitHub (⭐1)](https://github.com/fonrex/fonrex)
*   [Seiche (⭐1)](https://github.com/beepboop2025/seiche) - `Python` `REST` `MCP` - Money-market and dollar-funding research with public-source collectors, historical observations, separate release and retrieval clocks, and explicit coverage gaps.
*   [CNEquity (⭐730)](https://github.com/rootSunc/CNEquity) - `Python` `MCP` `A-shares` - Self-hosted China A-share data lake that keeps 55 datasets (prices, financials, capital flows, corporate events, futures and options) in local Parquet with incremental updates, point-in-time queries, delisted-stock retention, DuckDB SQL and a read-only MCP server.
*   [yfinance-ir (⭐2)](https://github.com/Fazel94/yfinance-ir) - `Python` - yfinance-shaped market data for Iranian markets: TSETMC equities, ETFs, indices and option chains, Codal financial statements, TGJU FX and gold, SCI CPI and Iranian crypto exchanges.
*   [ws-wire-audit (⭐0)](https://github.com/Robin1987China/ws-wire-audit) - `Python` - WebSocket wire-level measurement tool for exchange market-data feeds: frame and control-frame accounting, payload-vs-wire byte ratios, compression negotiation checks, and a documented API-contract audit.
*   [edgar-full-text-search-examples (⭐0)](https://github.com/svitury/edgar-full-text-search-examples) - `Python` `SEC EDGAR` - Stdlib-only EDGAR full-text search to CSV that splits date ranges to get past the 10,000-result cap.
*   [ninjatrader-to-parquet (⭐10)](https://github.com/tbraman-dev/ninjatrader-to-parquet) - `Python` - NinjaTrader 8 .ncd tick and minute history files to Parquet without NinjaTrader running; row-exact against NinjaTrader's own export, incremental re-runs.

##### Financial Instruments & Pricing

*   [vanna (⭐2)](https://github.com/heykav/vanna) - `Python` - Black-Scholes and CRR-binomial options pricing with Greek-attributed backtest P\&L, decomposing each trade into delta, gamma, theta, vega, vanna, and volga via a second-order Taylor expansion.
*   [stochPathSim (⭐15)](https://github.com/AIM-IT4/stochPathSim) - `Python` - Stochastic path simulation (Heston, rough Bergomi, Kou, curve-fitted Hull-White and G2++, CIR, commodity and credit models) with Monte Carlo pricing, exposure/CVA, risk-factor backtesting and a model-validation lab producing interactive Plotly HTML reports.
*   [CustomDerivative](https://cran.r-project.org/package=CustomDerivative) - `R` - Black-Scholes-Merton pricing, Monte Carlo with antithetic and control variates and confidence intervals, path-dependent payoffs and finite-difference Greeks. [GitHub (⭐2)](https://github.com/AIM-IT4/CustomDerivative)
*   [stochastic-rs](https://stochastic.rust-dd.com) - `Rust` `Python` - Quantitative finance library with 130+ stochastic processes, option pricing and calibration, volatility surfaces and copulas, SIMD/GPU accelerated with Python bindings. [GitHub (⭐194)](https://github.com/rust-dd/stochastic-rs)

##### Technical Indicators

*   [Repaint Check (⭐0)](https://github.com/arnjesix/stratcorealpha-pine-repaint-check) - `Pine` - Records an EMA-cross signal during realtime bars and marks signals absent at the confirmed close.
*   [yfinance-ta-patterns (⭐1)](https://github.com/eminsk/yfinance-ta-patterns) - `Python` - Candlestick and chart pattern recognition library for Yahoo Finance OHLCV market data.
*   [technical-indicators (⭐0)](https://github.com/Pinxitu/technical-indicators) - `TypeScript` - Dependency-free technical indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger, ATR, ADX, Ichimoku, SuperTrend…) with hand-verifiable tests, open datasets with provenance and reproducible behaviour reports.
*   [gamma-seed (⭐2)](https://github.com/Timonkru/gamma-seed) - `Python` `Pine` `Options` - Daily dealer-gamma levels (gamma flip, call and put walls, max pain, expected move) for DAX, Nasdaq, Dow and gold, computed from options open interest (Eurex ODAX for the DAX, ETF proxies for the US) and written into a TradingView Pine v6 indicator; the method is documented in open studies on the author's site. [Website](https://kruegeralgorithms.com/en/research)

##### Trading & Backtesting

*   [QuantDinger (⭐13k)](https://github.com/OpenByteInc/QuantDinger) - `Python` - Self-hosted platform for AI-assisted Python strategy development, backtesting, and paper and live trading across crypto exchanges and traditional brokers.
*   [ALPHAC (⭐1)](https://github.com/arhancanli/alphac) - `Python` - Cross-asset research and paper-trading engine with point-in-time data, walk-forward validation, multiple-testing accounting and a published forward record.
*   [trading-research-agents (⭐36)](https://github.com/BijectiveLabs/trading-research-agents) - `Python` `MCP` - Autonomous trading system for crypto linear perpetuals in which language models only propose and deterministic rules decide: code computes every figure, prices the full round trip before an order exists, sizes from the operator's risk at the stop, keeps exits at the exchange, and records each cycle with a per-file SHA-256 that can be re-verified.
*   [Desic Terminal (⭐33)](https://github.com/xiazhi88/Desic-Terminal) - `Rust` `TypeScript` - MIT-licensed desktop terminal for OKX USDT perpetuals that pairs live discretionary trading with systematic research: realtime WebSocket market data, 24 indicators, a market-wide radar, AI assistants with typed wake conditions, and a bundled Python runtime for 1-minute backtests.   • DC Hub (⭐3) - Live data for data-center site selection: a daily Data Center Power Index (DCPI) of where data centers can get grid power across 300+ markets, live grid feeds from the seven US ISOs, plus fiber, gas and electricity prices. Answers carry an as-of timestamp and a citation line. 94 tools, remote Streamable HTTP, free tier needs no key. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/azmartone67/dchub-mcp-server.
  • Google Hotels MCP (⭐1) - Search Google Hotels and Google Vacation Rentals from Gemini CLI: per-OTA nightly rates (Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda, Vrbo, Airbnb, Hotels.com and 10+ other providers), 3-month daily price calendars, amenities, nearby places and review topics. Local stdio server (3 tools) wrapping Apify Google Hotels actors; uvx --from "git+https://github.com/huynhtanan/google-hotels-mcp.git@v0.1.2" google-hotels-mcp.
  • AltoRank - Open-source SEO content software with a hosted MCP server: check whether search engines and AI crawlers can read a site, research keywords, read Google Search Console, and write sourced drafts into a person's review queue. No approve or publish tool. AGPL-3.0 and self-hostable (source (⭐3)). Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in. Add with gemini mcp add --transport http altorank https://app.altorank.co/api/mcp.

17. Free for Dev

APIs, Data, and ML

  • App AI Gateway - Gateway/proxy for calling AI providers from iOS applications without shipping provider keys or building your own backend. Only allows requests from your real app via App Attest, with rate limits and budgets per user and per app. The free plan includes 1,000 requests per month, no card required.

  • PostEverywhere (⭐0) - Social media scheduler for Gemini CLI. Write, schedule and publish posts to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Threads, Pinterest and Bluesky, and plan a content calendar. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/posteverywhere/gemini-cli-extension (posteverywhere.ai).

Also includes a context-hygiene checklist and a fill-in handoff template. MIT.

MCP Servers

Accounts are connected once in the browser and kept in Aident Vault, and every action is logged in Audit. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in; free pay-as-you-go start. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http aident https://loadout.aident.ai/mcp.
  • CurlShot - Screenshot API with a hosted MCP server: take_screenshot renders any web page in a real browser and returns the image (PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF; full page, device presets, ad and cookie-banner blocking), so Gemini CLI can see a page, and list_devices lists the presets. Remote Streamable HTTP with a CurlShot API key; the server is closed source. Free plan of 100 screenshots a month, no card. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http curlshot https://curlshot.com/api/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $CURLSHOT_API_KEY".

Documentation & Examples

  • Gemini CLI limits & pricing (QuotaBurn) - Source-linked guide to Gemini CLI daily request quotas, the free-tier change, and per-token API cost.

*   [Tars](https://tars.saccolabs.com?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - A local-first autonomous supervisor and sidekick powered by Google Gemini. ##### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [IssueDB](https://issue-queue.readthedocs.io/en/latest/llm_agents.html?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - LLM frendly command-line issue tracking system for software development projects, with built-in interface, context support and prompt providers for Gemini CLI and others.
*   [MCP Config Doctor](https://mcpconfigdoctor.online/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Browser-local diagnostic that validates Gemini CLI `~/.gemini/settings.json` MCP server entries (shape, env/secret references, transport fields). Also covers Claude Code, Codex CLI, and VS Code MCP configs. No account, no telemetry, no remote calls — runs entirely in the browser.
*   [Usage HUD](https://hud.thaliabloom.com/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Native macOS menu-bar meter that shows your Gemini CLI usage window next to Claude, Codex, Grok and Ollama, with a confidence label on every number. Paid, $9.
*   [Agent Cat](https://agentcat.app?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Free macOS/Windows menu-bar app that shows Gemini CLI and Antigravity usage and limits next to Claude Code and Codex, read from local files.

Also supports Claude Code, Codex and other agents. Free, with a paid Pro tier.
*   [SkillKeeper](https://skillkeeper.app/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - macOS menu bar app that reads local Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions to show which skills, agents, MCP servers and tools ran, how often, and what they cost in tokens. Native Swift, free to track.

Exports SVG/PNG cards or JSON; no account, no upload, no dependencies. MIT. Run: `npx github:henrikdukefoss/tokenreceipt`.

Install: `gemini mcp add --transport http skillagent https://skillagent.dev/mcp`.
*   [LogNorm](https://lognorm.com?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Hosted remote MCP server that hands a website's SEO and AI-visibility (GEO) backlog (site audits, fixes, content drafts, AI-answer tracking) to coding agents. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, no API key; free plan available. Source: [lognorm/lognorm-mcp (⭐2)](https://github.com/lognorm/lognorm-mcp). Add with: `gemini mcp add --transport http lognorm https://lognorm.com/api/mcp`.
*   [LinkMCP](https://app.linkmcp.io?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Hosted LinkedIn MCP server for your own LinkedIn account: profile and company lookups, people and Sales Navigator search, inbox, posts and comments, connection requests, and work email finding. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in; the server is closed source. Paid plans from $19/month, 7-day free trial without a card. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/linkmcp-io/linkmcp`.
*   [FXMacroData](https://fxmacrodata.com?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Official macroeconomic releases, central bank decisions, release calendars, FX rates and COT positioning for 22 currencies, with release timestamps and source links. Remote Streamable HTTP server; USD releases (last 90 days, 15-minute delay), the USD calendar and the USD catalogue work with no sign-in or API key, other currencies and FX rates need a key. Add with: `gemini mcp add --transport http fxmacrodata https://mcp.fxmacrodata.com`.
*   [LinkedNav](https://www.linkednav.com/mcp?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Hosted MCP server for LinkedIn outreach in your own LinkedNav account: find leads, launch campaigns, send, and reply. LinkedNav detects LinkedIn buying signals and sends personalized outreach you approve. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key; the server is closed source. Free 7-day trial. An independent service, not affiliated with LinkedIn. Add with: `gemini mcp add --transport http linkednav https://mcp.linkednav.com/`.
*   [HeyReagent](https://heyreagent.com/linkedin-mcp?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Hosted LinkedIn MCP server for your own LinkedIn account: read your inbox, send messages and invitations, search people, and work with posts. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, no key to paste; the server is closed source. Free plan available. An independent service, not affiliated with LinkedIn. Add with: `gemini mcp add --transport http heyreagent https://api.heyreagent.com/mcp`.
*   [Latchkey](https://latchkey.dev/documentation/connect-your-ai-agent?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Self-healing GitHub Actions runners with a hosted MCP server for coding agents: read the CI failures self-heal could not fix (root cause, failing file, logs), check run status, dispatch workflows, and run commands on fresh ephemeral runners. Remote Streamable HTTP with a Latchkey API key; the server is closed source. Add with: `gemini mcp add --transport http latchkey https://latchkey.dev/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $LATCHKEY_TOKEN"`.

#### [19. Free for Dev](/content/ripienaar/free-for-dev/README.md)

##### Feature Toggles Management Platforms

*   [Flagpool](https://www.flagpool.io/en/) - Feature flag management platform with a focus on simplicity and ease of use. Free plan includes creating up to 10 new flags per month, unlimited requests and targeting rules.

##### PaaS

*   [Staxa](https://staxa.dev/) - Multi-tenant app hosting: each tenant gets its own app, database, subdomain and TLS in an isolated Kubernetes namespace through either a web app or API integration. Free tier includes 2 tenants with up to 2 services each (0.5 vCPU, 512 MB), free apps sleep after 24 hours of being idle.

Install: gemini mcp add --transport http skillagent https://skillagent.dev/mcp.
  • LogNorm - Hosted remote MCP server that hands a website's SEO and AI-visibility (GEO) backlog (site audits, fixes, content drafts, AI-answer tracking) to coding agents. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, no API key; free plan available. Source: lognorm/lognorm-mcp (⭐2). Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http lognorm https://lognorm.com/api/mcp.
  • LinkMCP - Hosted LinkedIn MCP server for your own LinkedIn account: profile and company lookups, people and Sales Navigator search, inbox, posts and comments, connection requests, and work email finding. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in; the server is closed source. Paid plans from $19/month, 7-day free trial without a card. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/linkmcp-io/linkmcp.
  • FXMacroData - Official macroeconomic releases, central bank decisions, release calendars, FX rates and COT positioning for 22 currencies, with release timestamps and source links. Remote Streamable HTTP server; USD releases (last 90 days, 15-minute delay), the USD calendar and the USD catalogue work with no sign-in or API key, other currencies and FX rates need a key. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http fxmacrodata https://mcp.fxmacrodata.com.
  • LinkedNav - Hosted MCP server for LinkedIn outreach in your own LinkedNav account: find leads, launch campaigns, send, and reply. LinkedNav detects LinkedIn buying signals and sends personalized outreach you approve. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key; the server is closed source. Free 7-day trial. An independent service, not affiliated with LinkedIn. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http linkednav https://mcp.linkednav.com/.
  • HeyReagent - Hosted LinkedIn MCP server for your own LinkedIn account: read your inbox, send messages and invitations, search people, and work with posts. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, no key to paste; the server is closed source. Free plan available. An independent service, not affiliated with LinkedIn. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http heyreagent https://api.heyreagent.com/mcp.
  • Latchkey - Self-healing GitHub Actions runners with a hosted MCP server for coding agents: read the CI failures self-heal could not fix (root cause, failing file, logs), check run status, dispatch workflows, and run commands on fresh ephemeral runners. Remote Streamable HTTP with a Latchkey API key; the server is closed source. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http latchkey https://latchkey.dev/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $LATCHKEY_TOKEN".

19. Free for Dev

Feature Toggles Management Platforms

  • Flagpool - Feature flag management platform with a focus on simplicity and ease of use. Free plan includes creating up to 10 new flags per month, unlimited requests and targeting rules.

PaaS

  • Staxa - Multi-tenant app hosting: each tenant gets its own app, database, subdomain and TLS in an isolated Kubernetes namespace through either a web app or API integration. Free tier includes 2 tenants with up to 2 services each (0.5 vCPU, 512 MB), free apps sleep after 24 hours of being idle.

[![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/dcoded-dev/songtide) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ##### Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process * [akou](https://geiserx.github.io/akou/) - Open-source call and meeting recorder that transcribes on-device with speaker labels and lets Claude Code or Codex question a call over MCP. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/GeiserX/akou) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") * [yovoice](https://yovoice.leemysw.com) - Local voice creation studio with text-to-speech, voice cloning, emotion control, song generation and MIDI scoring, all running on-device. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/leemysw/yovoice) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") #### [20. Free for Dev](/content/ripienaar/free-for-dev/README.md) ##### APIs, Data, and ML * [Jsonpage](https://jsonpage.com/en/) - Company data API for France and 13 other countries (SIREN, SIRET, VAT check). Free plan: 1,000 requests per day, no credit card. ##### Security and PKI * [SubdomainWatch](https://www.subdomainwatch.com/) - Attack surface monitoring and CI/CD takeover guard. Free standalone DNS scanner, GitHub Action with SARIF export, and continuous asset monitoring tier.

#### [4. Awesome Blazor](/content/AdrienTorris/awesome-blazor/README.md)

##### Videos / Others

*   [.NET Day Online 2026, by JetBrains](https://www.youtube.com/live/adwmjYzQhaU?si=g9SNYD-JnE3c8XPb\&t=19792) - October 7, 2026 - ![duration](https://img.shields.io/badge/Duration:%20-32%20min-%230094FF?style=flat-square\&cacheSeconds=maxAge\&logo=youtube) Escape the Monolith: Scaling Blazor with .NET Aspire and Azure Container Apps, with Michael Washington.
*   [Blazor Hybrid: One UI for Web, iOS, Android & Desktop (.NET MAUI)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b9siFlZE6XQ) - July 20, 2026 - ![duration](https://img.shields.io/badge/Duration:%20-65%20min-%230094FF?style=flat-square\&cacheSeconds=maxAge\&logo=youtube) Blazor Hybrid + .NET MAUI: build your UI once with Razor components and ship it to the browser, iOS, Android, Windows, and macOS – with full native API access from a single .NET codebase. David Ortinau, Principal Product Manager on the .NET team at Microsoft, breaks down how Blazor Hybrid works under the hood: Razor components hosted in a BlazorWebView, running in one .NET process with no web server on the device. He walks through the .NET MAUI Blazor Web App template, native platform concerns like Android safe areas, and real production-grade Blazor Hybrid apps – Sentence Studio (an AI-powered language learning app orchestrated with .NET Aspire), PolyPilot (an app the .NET MAUI team built entirely with AI agents), and MAUI Sherpa (an open-source toolbox for cross-platform developers). He also shares the .NET 11 roadmap: CoreCLR as the single runtime across platforms (WASM support still in progress), the path to Native AOT, .NET Watch everywhere, a unified Hot Reload pipeline, and MAUI DevFlow – tooling that gives AI coding agents eyes and hands inside your running app.

David Ortinau, Principal Product Manager on the .NET team at Microsoft, breaks down how Blazor Hybrid works under the hood: Razor components hosted in a BlazorWebView, running in one .NET process with no web server on the device. He walks through the .NET MAUI Blazor Web App template, native platform concerns like Android safe areas, and real production-grade Blazor Hybrid apps – Sentence Studio (an AI-powered language learning app orchestrated with .NET Aspire), PolyPilot (an app the .NET MAUI team built entirely with AI agents), and MAUI Sherpa (an open-source toolbox for cross-platform developers). He also shares the .NET 11 roadmap: CoreCLR as the single runtime across platforms (WASM support still in progress), the path to Native AOT, .NET Watch everywhere, a unified Hot Reload pipeline, and MAUI DevFlow – tooling that gives AI coding agents eyes and hands inside your running app.

Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key; the server is closed source, included on every paid plan with a free trial. Add with gemini mcp add --transport http blawgy https://app.blawgy.com/mcp.

For claimed sites, ask it for visitors, leads or site status. Remote Streamable HTTP, no sign-in for the first publish, or local stdio via npx -y dropthehassle-mcp. MIT. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http dropthehassle https://dropthehassle.com/mcp.
